sections.title: Front matter

summary.text: The front matter of the Spanish edition of WHO's Global strategy on digital health 2020–2025, beginning with the title, ISBNs and Creative Commons licence terms. A table of contents lists sections from vision and purpose to monitoring, a glossary and an annex of proposed actions. It then recounts the two-year development of the strategy, approved by the Seventy-third World Health Assembly, and recalls earlier WHO resolutions and guidance on digital interventions. Introductory text states that digital health should be ethical, safe, equitable and sustainable, with notes on data privacy and on engagement with non-State actors.

sections.title: VISIÓN

summary.text: Sets out the strategy's vision of improving health for everyone by accelerating people-centred, affordable, scalable and sustainable digital health solutions, including for epidemics and pandemics. It explains that digital health will be valued if it supports equitable access to quality services, health system efficiency and generation of evidence on costs, quality and safety.

sections.extract: La visión de la estrategia mundial consiste en mejorar la salud de todos en todas partes al acelerar el fomento y la adopción de soluciones de salud digital centradas en las personas que resulten adecuadas, accesibles, asequibles, escalables y sostenibles para prevenir, detectar y responder a epidemias y pandemias, desarrollando infraestructuras y aplicaciones que permitan a los países utilizar los datos sanitarios

sections.title: FINALIDAD

summary.text: States the strategy's purpose of strengthening health systems through digital technologies aimed at consumers, health workers, providers and industry, and of being usable by all Member States, including those with limited digital access. It defines digital health as a field extending the concept of eHealth and notes the strategy's 2020–2025 timeframe.

sections.title: DE SALUD NACIONALES REQUIERE QUE LOS PAÍSES ADOPTEN DECISIONES Y SE COMPROMETAN

summary.text: Affirms that each country owns its digital health action plan and will adopt digital health in a way that fits its sovereignty, culture, policies and resources.

sections.extract: QUE LOS PAÍSES ADOPTEN DECISIONES Y SE COMPROMETAN La estrategia mundial reconoce que cada país es dueño del plan de acción en materia de salud digital configurado a partir de la estrategia, dentro del propio contexto nacional. sections.title: RECONOCER QUE LAS INICIATIVAS DE SALUD DIGITAL, PARA SER EFICACES, PRECISAN UNA ESTRATEGIA INTEGRADA

summary.text: Explains that digital health initiatives need an integrated national strategy combining leadership, finance, institutions, people and technology, supported by governance, standards and interoperable architecture, since uncoordinated efforts lead to fragmented solutions.

sections.title: PROMOVER EL USO ADECUADO DE LAS TECNOLOGÍAS DIGITALES PARA LA SALUD

summary.text: Describes a principle of promoting appropriate use of digital technologies as adaptable digital public goods, while protecting people and health systems from misinformation, misuse of data, cyber threats and rights violations. It notes digital determinants of health such as digital literacy and warns against fragmented vertical information systems.

sections.extract: PARA LA SALUD La estrategia mundial promueve el uso adecuado de las tecnologías digitales como bienes públicos digitales que se pueden adaptar a diferentes países y contextos para solucionar los problemas de un sistema sanitario en pro de la equidad en el acceso a los recursos digitales para que no se deje a nadie atrás. summary.text: Calls for investment to overcome barriers faced by less developed countries in adopting digital health, such as infrastructure, skills, funding and connectivity, and says digital health should be people-centred, evidence-based, inclusive and attentive to electronic waste.

sections.title: PROMOVER LA COLABORACIÓN EN EL PLANO MUNDIAL Y FOMENTAR LA TRANSFERENCIA DE CONOCIMIENTOS DE SALUD DIGITAL

summary.text: Describes the first strategic objective, which aims to align countries and stakeholders around global collaboration and transfer of digital health knowledge while managing related risks. It mentions maximizing partnerships and assessing the quality and outcomes of new health technologies.

sections.title: OBJETIVOS ESTRATÉGICOS

summary.text: Continues the first strategic objective, stressing the need for norms, policies and regulations to ensure the quality and safety of digital health products, including those sold directly to individuals. It introduces proposed policy options and actions for global coordination and adoption of digital tools.

sections.title: IMPULSAR LA EJECUCIÓN DE ESTRATEGIAS NACIONALES DE SALUD DIGITAL

summary.text: Describes the second strategic objective, which supports countries in owning, adapting and strengthening national digital health strategies through a multistakeholder approach. It lists core building blocks such as leadership and governance, investment, services and applications, standards and interoperability, infrastructure, workforce and legislation. Expected outputs include a national digital health strategy that is embedded in the overall national health strategy.

sections.extract: SALUD DIGITAL El segundo objetivo estratégico aspira a estimular y apoyar a todos los países para que hagan suyas, adapten y fortalezcan sus estrategias de salud digital de la manera que mejor se ajuste a su visión, contexto nacional, situación y tendencias sanitarias, recursos disponibles y valores centrales. sections.title: FORTALECER LA GOBERNANZA EN PRO DE LA SALUD DIGITAL EN LOS PLANOS MUNDIAL, REGIONAL Y NACIONAL

summary.text: Describes the third strategic objective of strengthening digital health governance at global, regional and national levels through sustainable structures and capacity building. It covers norms on security, privacy, interoperability and ethical data use, as well as intersectoral and international agreements on data sharing.

sections.extract: LOS PLANOS MUNDIAL, REGIONAL Y NACIONAL El tercer objetivo estratégico se centra en reforzar la gobernanza de la salud digital en los planos nacional e internacional mediante la creación de estructuras de gobernanza sostenibles y sólidas y el fortalecimiento de la capacidad en salud digital en los planos mundial y nacional. sections.title: PROPUGNAR SISTEMAS DE SALUD CENTRADOS EN LAS PERSONAS FACILITADOS POR MEDIO DE LA SALUD DIGITAL

summary.text: Describes the fourth strategic objective, which puts people at the centre of digital health by promoting digital health literacy, gender equality, women's empowerment and inclusive approaches. It also lists expected outputs under the governance objective, including global rules on health data use, principles for data sharing and artificial intelligence research, and guidance on personalized medicine.

sections.title: Comprometerse

summary.text: Describes the commit component of the framework for action, encouraging countries and stakeholders to commit to implementing the strategy within national priorities and resources.

sections.extract: Alentar a los países y a las partes interesadas a que se comprometan a aplicar la estrategia mundial sobre salud digital. Para alcanzar los objetivos estratégicos de la estrategia mundial, la Secretaría, los Estados Miembros y las partes interesadas mantendrán su compromiso y sus aportaciones voluntarias, respetando las prioridades, las capacidades y los recursos nacionales.

sections.title: Catalizar

summary.text: Describes the catalyse component of the framework for action, under which the Secretariat fosters a collaborative environment to introduce and scale up digital health technologies.

sections.extract: Generar y sustentar un entorno propicio para crear, ampliar y mantener procesos que faciliten la colaboración centrada en ejecutar la estrategia mundial. sections.title: MARCO DE ACCIÓN

summary.text: Introduces the framework for action, which offers a collaborative structure built around four components (commit, catalyse, measure, and enhance and iterate) and is accompanied by an action plan.

sections.extract: El marco de acción tiene por objeto facilitar la aplicación de la estrategia mundial al ofrecer una estructura y herramientas de colaboración. Mediante el trabajo colaborativo encaminado a lograr objetivos estratégicos comunes, los asociados locales y mundiales pueden dar cabida a la diversidad y analizar conjuntamente conceptos, hojas de ruta, metodologías, herramientas, fuentes de financiación y otros factores con

sections.title: Medir

summary.text: Describes the measure component, under which the Secretariat evaluates the strategy's effectiveness using global data and reports findings to Member States.

sections.extract: Crear y adoptar procesos y parámetros para supervisar y evaluar la eficacia de la estrategia mundial. Este componente requiere una evaluación constante para determinar si la estrategia mundial sobre salud digital ha sido fiel a su propósito y ha brindado un apoyo eficaz a los países. sections.title: Mejorar e iterar

summary.text: Describes the enhance and iterate component, under which the action plan is reviewed annually and refined in response to feedback and new digital technologies.

sections.extract: Poner en marcha un nuevo ciclo de acciones sobre la base de lo que se ha observado, medido y analizado. Este componente responderá a la retroinformación sobre la marcha de la estrategia mundial en lo referente a la adaptación a las nuevas tecnologías de salud digital. El plan de acción se revisará anualmente con el fin de determinar si es necesario un nuevo ciclo de acciones para alcanzar los objetivos estratégicos.

sections.title: APLICACIÓN DE LA ESTRATEGIA Y PLAN DE ACCIÓN

summary.text: Introduces implementation of the strategy and its action plan, linking it to universal health coverage, the health-related Sustainable Development Goals and WHO's Thirteenth General Programme of Work. It sets out general implementation principles for collaboration between the Secretariat, Member States and partners. Proposed actions are grouped into short-, medium- and long-term timeframes.

sections.extract: DE ACCIÓN Mediante la estrategia mundial sobre salud digital se apoyará y dará respuesta a la creciente necesidad de los países de aplicar tecnologías digitales pertinentes para abordar sus prioridades de salud y ampliar sus avances encaminados a lograr la cobertura sanitaria universal y los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible relacionados con la salud. sections.title: PRINCIPIOS ESPECÍFICOS DE APLICACIÓN

summary.text: Sets out specific implementation principles for an interoperable national digital health ecosystem able to exchange data across borders. It calls for agreed use cases, standards and specifications, a strong legal framework protecting confidentiality and data integrity, and a coordinated global initiative on the economics of health data.

sections.extract: ESPECÍFICOS DE APLICACIÓN El ecosistema de salud digital interoperable de un país debe configurarse de modo que las infraestructuras informáticas sanitarias sean interoperables entre sí y puedan intercambiar datos sanitarios con infraestructuras de otros países pese a las diferencias nacionales en materia de leyes y políticas. sections.title: SUPERVISIÓN Y EVALUACIÓN

summary.text: Covers monitoring and evaluation of the strategy, asking Member States and the Secretariat to track digital health maturity and assess national strategies using agreed indicators and a value measurement model. It is followed by a glossary of digital health terms. A long annex then tabulates actions proposed for Member States, the Secretariat and partners over short, medium and long terms under each of the four strategic objectives. The final entries, under the people-centred objective, concern digital literacy, change management and feedback frameworks.

sections.extract: En el plan de acción se pide a los Estados Miembros y a la Secretaría que supervisen activamente el nivel de madurez digital en salud de los países y las instituciones y que evalúen la aplicación de las estrategias de salud digital mediante parámetros normalizados consensuados.
